mapper.select: SELECT h.member_id, h.stock_id, h.shares, h.average_cost, h.updated_at, s.name, s.type, s.market, s.industry FROM stock_holding h JOIN stock s ON s.stock_id = h.stock_id WHERE h.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY h.stock_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_holding (member_id, stock_id, shares, average_cost, updated_at) VALUES (#{h.id.memberId}, #{h.id.stockId}, #{h.shares}, #{h.averageCost}, #{h.updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE shares = VALUES(shares), average_cost = VALUES(average_cost), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stock_holding WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND stock_id = #{stockId}
